description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Multiversal Incursion twice
Resolve all Multiversal Incursion spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.name: Echo Mage
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher
